$comment: VP9 codec for the WebM stack. libvpx has no CMake build of its own; vcpkg's port handles the autotools/NASM/per-arch-target mess for us. libyuv provides SIMD RGB<->I420 conversion for the encoder/decoder hot path. libwebm is fetched separately via FetchContent (no vcpkg port exists). No builtin-baseline: we resolve deps from whatever vcpkg checkout the build uses (the runner's preinstalled vcpkg, or VCPKG_ROOT). To pin exactly, vendor vcpkg as a submodule and add its commit as builtin-baseline.
name: webp-natives
